name: perfect-clock
description: Plan meetings across time zones: dates and local times for everyone, with working hours, public holidays and daylight saving time checked.

interface.longDescription:
Perfect Clock plans meetings between people in different time zones.

Describe the meeting the way you would to a colleague - "a 30-minute call every other Tuesday at 10:00 Berlin time with Dana in Tel Aviv and the Sydney team" - and get the upcoming dates with each participant's local time side by side.

What it checks for you:
- Working hours of every participant, with the meetings that fall outside them flagged
- Weekends and public holidays in each participant's country
- Daylight saving time changes, including the weeks when Europe and the US switch on different dates and a recurring meeting moves on someone's clock
- Weekly, biweekly, monthly ("second Tuesday", "last Friday") and one-off meetings

Not sure when to meet yet? Ask for the windows when everyone is within working hours over the next days, then plan the series at one of them.

"Open in Perfect Clock" puts the whole series on the timelines of everyone's cities; sign in to keep it next to your own calendar.

A planned schedule is kept for 30 days behind a private link that never contains meeting titles or names. No account is needed to plan.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 30-minute team sync every other Tuesday at 10:00 Berlin time with Tel Aviv and Dubai
When can I meet my colleague in London for an hour this week? I'm in Dubai.
Monthly review on the last Thursday of each month at 4 pm Seoul time with Sydney and Dubai

positive.description: Recurring meeting across a daylight saving time change
positive.prompt: Plan a 30-minute team sync every other Tuesday at 9:00 Berlin time with Tel Aviv and Dubai, starting March 16, 2027. Show the next 3 meetings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_meeting_schedule (tz Europe/Berlin, 09:00, weekly, interval 2, TU, start 2027-03-16). Meetings on Mar 16, Mar 30 and Apr 13, 2027: Berlin 09:00, Tel Aviv 10:00; Dubai 12:00 on Mar 16, then 11:00 from Mar 30 (Europe moves its clocks on Mar 28, Dubai has no DST), with a note about the shift. Shows the schedule widget and an Open in Perfect Clock link (https://perfectclock.cc/s/<token>).

positive.description: Finding a common window around public holidays
positive.prompt: When can I meet my colleague in London for an hour between December 24 and 26, 2026? I'm in Dubai.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_meeting_windows (tz Asia/Dubai, from 2026-12-24, 3 days, 60 minutes). Dec 24: window 13:00-17:00 Dubai / 09:00-13:00 London. Dec 25: no window, Christmas Day in London. Dec 26: no window, weekend in Dubai and Boxing Day in London.

positive.description: Monthly meeting on the last weekday of the month
positive.prompt: Monthly review on the last Thursday of each month at 4 pm Seoul time with Sydney and Dubai, from January 2027, 3 meetings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_meeting_schedule (tz Asia/Seoul, 16:00, monthly, setPos -1, TH). Meetings on Jan 28, Feb 25 and Mar 25, 2027: Seoul 16:00-17:00, Sydney 18:00-19:00, Dubai 11:00-12:00, with a note that all three are outside working hours in Sydney.

positive.description: The week when the US and Europe are out of sync
positive.prompt: I have a 3 pm London call with New York every weekday. What time is it for them each day from March 8 to March 19, 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_meeting_schedule (tz Europe/London, 15:00, weekly MO-FR, start 2027-03-08). New York 10:00 on Mar 8-12 and 11:00 from Mar 15 (the US moves its clocks on Mar 14, the UK on Mar 28), with a note about the change.

positive.description: A weekly meeting that falls on someone's weekend
positive.prompt: Weekly 45-minute sync every Friday at 11:00 London time with the team in Tel Aviv, starting January 8, 2027. Show 3 meetings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_meeting_schedule (tz Europe/London, 11:00, weekly FR, start 2027-01-08). Meetings on Jan 8, 15 and 22, 2027 at 11:00 London / 13:00 Tel Aviv, each flagged as a day off (weekend) in Tel Aviv, where the weekend is Friday and Saturday.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: General knowledge question about a city
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Writing task with no meeting to plan
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea.
